text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES'] + df['NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES'] <= df['IN_PKTS'] + df['OUT_PKTS']"],"features":["NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES","NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES","NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES","NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES","NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES","IN_PKTS","OUT_PKTS"],"rationale":"The disjoint packet-size bins count subsets of the flow's packets, and packets larger than 1514 bytes need not be represented in any bin."},{"id":"R2","category":"count_semantics","alternatives":["df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS'] + df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS'] <= df['IN_PKTS'] + df['OUT_PKTS']"],"features":["RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS","RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS","IN_PKTS","OUT_PKTS"],"rationale":"Retransmitted packets in either direction are a subset of the packets observed in the flow."}]}
